dogecoin.text: @ali_charts Dogecoin waking up like it’s 2021 again!

Dogecoin was never just a joke.

It was the first case study in community > code.

They literally had no whitepaper. No tokenomics. Just memes, momentum, and belief.

10 years later, memecoins are still teaching us this: 

“Attention is the real alpha.”

Memecoins weren’t meant to be serious.
Then Dogecoin happened.
A meme, a Shiba, and boom — a multi-billion dollar market cap.

Now whole ecosystems are built off vibes.
Lesson?
“In crypto, culture is utility.”

Note this legend!

@cryptojack $DOGE is an internet culture artifact powered by vibes, Elon, and 1,000,000 degens on caffeine. ☕🐶
memes with momentum never die.
